description: This file defines the TestMultiSegmentBufferWriter class, which implements buffer writing interfaces for testing purposes within the Orleans.Serialization.TestKit namespace. It manages multiple byte segments, allowing for buffer advancement, memory and span retrieval, and sequence reading.

classes.name: TestMultiSegmentBufferWriter
classes.description: A buffer writer class for testing that manages multiple byte segments, supporting buffer advancement, memory and span access, and sequence retrieval.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the buffer by a specified number of bytes, committing the current buffer segment.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Provides a Memory<byte> segment with at least the specified size hint.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Provides a Span<byte> with at least the specified size hint.

methods.name: GetReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Returns a ReadOnlySequence<byte> composed of committed buffers, batched by max segment size.

methods.name: PeekAllBuffers
methods.description: Returns a ReadOnlySequence<byte> of all committed buffers plus the current buffer.
